verdict.rationale: Proposal-gate North Star check only (no patch, no tools). The reproduced Codex no-op (execute plus two fix passes on the same 78/79 RED, zero source edits) is an executor that cannot read the frozen plan’s files, so waves do not reach verified done and attention is burned between gates. Change 1 restores file work on execute/fix only, default prompt text unchanged, dual-gated to FOREMAN_CODEX_CONPTY=1 and Anchor CODING_FAMILY=chatgpt, verification prompts untouched, git and test suites still orchestrator-only — that preserves ground-truth gates on the orchestrator and the ConPTY reason for the original shell ban. Change 2 is the authorized YOLO opt-in, not a silent default: WRITE_ROLES only, execute/fix default remains workspace-write, verification/judge/shark stay read-only, unknown/synthesis never gain danger-full-access, Windows unelevated stays workspace-write, receipt records the sandbox actually selected. CUT list holds: no new transport, wrapper, polling engine, model defaults, fallback ladder, checkpoint, GO-rule, or Chekhov product change; first frozen human writing sitting remains a halt. Refutations of scope creep, role widening, and ineffective compatibility therefore do not hold at proposal grade.

findings.detail: Helper phrase “necessary in-scope implementation operations” is looser than the failure (Codex has no nonterminal file reader) and looser than the proposed tests (“file work”). Pin helper copy to batched terminal read/search plus in-workspace file create/edit/delete when dedicated file tools are absent; keep the existing git/test orchestrator-only ban. Otherwise a later patch can smuggle installs, servers, or self-run suites under YOLO without changing this proposal’s sentence.

Sandbox YOLO and the ConPTY prompt gate are independent. Keep them independent in the patch: danger-full-access must not imply terminal permission, and FOREMAN_CODEX_CONPTY=1 must not imply unrestricted sandbox. Receipt already required to stamp the sandbox actually selected, including the Windows unelevated workspace-write path.
